import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
import warnings
import os
import sys

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data - specify exact paths from Data Overview
input_dir = "./input"
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/sample_submission_null.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}, Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Columns in train: {list(train_df.columns)}")
print(f"Columns in test: {list(test_df.columns)}")
print(f"Sample submission columns: {list(sample_submission.columns)}")


# Decode unicode escapes in comments
def decode_unicode(text):
    def replace_unicode(match):
        return chr(int(match.group()[-4:], 16))

    text = str(text).replace("\\n", " ").replace("\\t", "")
    return re.sub(r"\\u[0-9a-fA-F]{4}", replace_unicode, text)


train_df["cleaned_comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(decode_unicode)
test_df["cleaned_comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(decode_unicode)

# Prepare features
X_train_raw = train_df["cleaned_comment"].values.astype(str)
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values.astype(float)
X_test_raw = test_df["cleaned_comment"].values.astype(str)

# Word level TF-IDF
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 3), max_features=15000, stop_words="english", lowercase=True
)

# Character level TF-IDF
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(3, 5), max_features=8000, lowercase=True
)


# Extract text statistics as additional features
def extract_text_stats(comment):
    text = str(comment).lower().strip()
    if not text or len(text) == 0:
        return np.zeros(10)

    text_clean = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", "", text)
    char_count = len(text_clean)
    word_list = text_clean.split()

    features = []
    features.append(len(text))
    features.append(len(word_list))
    features.append(len(re.findall(r"\d+", text)))
    features.append(len(re.findall(r'[!@#$%^&*(),.?":{}|<>]', text)))
    features.append(len(set([word.lower() for word in word_list])))
    features.append(char_count / max(len(text_clean), 1))
    features.append(len(word_list) / max(len(text_clean), 1))
    upper_count = sum([c.isupper() for c in text])
    features.append(upper_count / max(char_count, 1))
    features.append(len(set(text)) / max(char_count, 1))

    return np.array(features, dtype=float)


X_train_stats = np.array([extract_text_stats(c) for c in X_train_raw], dtype=float)
X_test_stats = np.array([extract_text_stats(c) for c in X_test_raw], dtype=float)

# Fit and transform TF-IDF
X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_test_raw)
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_test_raw)

# Combine TF-IDF features
X_train_tfidf = np.hstack([X_train_word.toarray(), X_train_char.toarray()])
X_test_tfidf = np.hstack([X_test_word.toarray(), X_test_char.toarray()])

# Combine all features with stats
X_train_all = np.hstack([X_train_tfidf, X_train_stats])
X_test_all = np.hstack([X_test_tfidf, X_test_stats])

# Stratified train/val split - critical for unbiased evaluation
X_train_final, X_val, y_train_final, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_all, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train LightGBM classifier with early stopping
lgb_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=1000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=63,
    min_child_samples=5,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    scale_pos_weight=len(y_train[y_train == 0]) / len(y_train[y_train == 1]),
    verbose=-1,
    force_col_wise=False,
    metric="auc",
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
)

early_stopping_rounds = 150
lgb_model.fit(
    X_train_final,
    y_train_final,
    eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(early_stopping_rounds, verbose=False)],
)

# Train Gradient Boosting classifier
gb_model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=400,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    max_depth=3,
    min_samples_split=20,
    min_samples_leaf=10,
    subsample=0.8,
    random_state=42,
    validation_fraction=0.05,
)

gb_model.fit(X_train_final, y_train_final)

# Grid search for optimal ensemble weights using holdout validation
weights_grid = [
    (0.3, 0.7),
    (0.4, 0.6),
    (0.5, 0.5),
    (0.6, 0.4),
    (0.7, 0.3),
]
best_auc = 0
best_weights = None

for w_lgb, w_gb in weights_grid:
    lgb_pred = lgb_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    gb_pred = gb_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    ensemble_pred = w_lgb * lgb_pred + w_gb * gb_pred
    auc_roc = roc_auc_score(y_val, ensemble_pred)
    if auc_roc > best_auc:
        best_auc = auc_roc
        best_weights = (w_lgb, w_gb)

print(f"Best validation AUC: {best_auc:.6f}")

# Make predictions on test set
lgb_test_pred = lgb_model.predict_proba(X_test_all)[:, 1]
gb_test_pred = gb_model.predict_proba(X_test_all)[:, 1]
test_pred = best_weights[0] * lgb_test_pred + best_weights[1] * gb_test_pred

# Clip extreme values to prevent numerical issues
test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 0.0001, 0.9999)

# Create submission - match the expected format from sample_submission
if list(sample_submission.columns) == ["Insult"]:
    submission = pd.DataFrame({"Insult": test_pred})
else:
    # Ensure index matches test_df order
    submission = pd.DataFrame({"Insult": test_pred.values})

print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Submission head:\n{submission.head()}")

# Save to the required location
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Saved submission to ./submission/submission.csv")

# Print only the validation AUC score as required
print(f"{best_auc:.6f}")
